g.text: Ticket Booking: Hold, Charge, Confirm -- with a Waiting Room at the Front Door
Every step after the hold claim can retry freely; the claim itself is the one atomic gate
Two clients both call POST /hold for the same seat within the same instant --
only one call's UPDATE can match status='available'; the other affects 0 rows.
The loser gets an immediate 409, no lock held, no retry loop -- and if the winner's
hold_expires_at passes without payment, a background sweep flips the seat back automatically.
